snippet.title: BattleTabs - Epic Battles PVP Strategy Game
snippet.description:
BattleTabs is the ultimate PvP turn-based strategy game!  You can play on desktop and on mobile now at https://battletabs.com!

Developed by Gangbusters.io, BattleTabs mixes mechanics inspired by classic Battleship with tactical abilities and a splash of nautical nonsense.

⚔️ Battle in PvP matches, inspired by Battleship but with tactical abilities
⚓ Customize your fleet of Vikings, pirates and sea monsters
🤝 Join our friendly Discord community of thousands
🏆 Compete for tournament glory
🤖 Host your own tournaments with our Discord BattleBot
